findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspector observed boxes of food items stored directly on the floor of the walk-in freezer connected to the main kitchen space. The PIC was informed and pallets/crates will be acquired to lift food items off the ground. Ensure storage is corrected prior to next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Inspector observed the following foods to be out of temperature. All items were probed: One Applewood Carving Ham (52F), Two Tubes of Salami (52F), One Capocollo Ham (52F), 5 Smoked Turkey Breasts (52F), 5 Boxes of Prepared Bacon (54F), 3 Boxes of Prepared Buffet Ham (52F), 3 Bags of Roast Beef (52.5F),  One Box of Smoked Bacon (52.5F), Three Boxes of Pepperoni (52.5F), 3 Containers of Roasted Garlic Base (52.5F), One Box of Roasted Poblano Base (52F), One Box of Chipotle Base (52.5F), Two Containers of Horseradish (51F), 4 Containers of Meijer Roasted Garlic Hummus (48.5F), One Container of Sabra Original Hummus (50.5F), Two Jars of Pesto (51F), Three Bags of Feta Crumbles (52F), One Box of Hard Boiled Eggs (51F), One Box of Goat Cheese (51F), One Box of Plain Greek Yogurt (51F), One Box + 4 Individual Containers of Whipped Cream (52F), Two Containers of Yogurt (52F), 4 Boxes of Yoplait (51.5F-52.5F), Two Boxes of Butter (51F), 3 Boxes of Single Serve Cream Cheese Spread (51F), One Box + One Container of Whipped Cream Cheese Spread (51.5, 53F), One Box of Cream Cheese (47.5F), 5 Boxes of Butter Chips (50-53F), 3 Cartons of Whole Eggs (52.5F), 3 Boxes of Heavy Cream (51-52F), 6 Boxes of Sliced Cheddar Cheese (50.5-52F),  One Box of Sliced Provolone Cheese (51.5F), Two Boxes of Sliced Jack Cheese with Peppers (51-51.5F), Two Boxes of Swiss Cheese (51.5F), One Package of Sliced American Cheese (51.5F), Two Containers of Ricotta Cheese (51F), Two Containers of Mozzarella (50.5-51.5F), 4 Cartons of Potato Salad (51F), 2 Boxes of Assorted Cheese Cubes (51.5, 52.5F), Two Boxes of Sour Cream (49.5, 51F), 3 Boxes of Shredded Mozzarella Cheese (49.5-52F), 4 Boxes of Shredded Cheddar Cheese (51-54F), Four Containers of French Dressing (52F), One Container of Chipotle Ranch (52F), One Container of Caesar Dressing (53F), Two Containers of BBQ Sauce (52.5F), Two Containers of Vinaigrette (52F), 3 Boxes of Chopped Cabbage Slaw Mix (48.5-51F), 6 Boxes of Cut Romaine Lettuce (50-52.5F), And One Bag of Salad Mix (53F). 

All Items were voluntarily discarded by PIC. Discussed with PIC; Ensure that the cooler temperature is checked regularly to prevent food spoilage. Cooler may need serviced to work properly.

Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control.
findings.comment:
The dish room cooler at the facility is not holding temperature. Inspector measured temperatures of food in the cooler to be between 48 and 52F. Food must be held at 41F or below. Discussed with PIC, and PIC called for service immediately. Inspector will return 09/19/2025 to re-inspect the temperature holding capabilities of the cooler. 

See violation 22 for food in the cooler.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.11 Cooling, Heating, and Holding Capacities. EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a build-up of soils on the baffle of the ice machine. Discussed with PIC, and PIC immediately cleaned and sanitized the baffle. Ensure the baffle is cleaned regularly enough to keep soils from accumulating.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the sliding door of the packaging room clear cooler is not completely shutting. The cooler is cold holding foods at proper temperatures (the ambient air is 35F). Ensure the door is repaired to properly shut. Physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
The back door in the dry storage area has a gap along the bottom and between the 2 doors, allowing sunlight through.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure gaps are sealed to prevent pest and rodent entry.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The main 3 part sink needs to be cleaned and re-caulked, the current caulk is mostly missing.  The left side stainless steel of the new dish machine also needs to be caulked to the wall. Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the 3 part sinks are re-caulked to create a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.
